hooks.command: mkdir -p "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docs/worklog" && jq -r --arg ts "$(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S')" --arg br "$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null || echo none)" '"\n## \($ts) · session:\(.session_id[0:8]) · branch:\($br)\n"' >> "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/docs/worklog/$(date '+%Y-%m-%d').md"
